```{r fonction}
tableau_html <- function(
    x,
    titre = NULL,
    digit = 4,
    align = "c",
    escape = TRUE,
    format = "html",
    style_police = "Roboto",
    col.names = colnames(x),
    row.names = TRUE,
    zoom = 1,
    small = FALSE,
    ...) {
  table <- x |>
    kable(
      caption = titre,
      align = align,
      format = format,
      digits = digit,
      escape = escape,
      col.names = col.names,
      row.names = row.names,
      ...
    )

  if (small) {
    table <- table |>
      kable_styling(
        full_width = FALSE,
        latex_options = c("hold_position", "scale_down", "longtable")
      )
  }

  table <- table |>
    kable_material(
      lightable_options = c("striped", "hover"),
      html_font = style_police,
      ...
    )

  return(table)
}



Collecte_mesure <- function(mat_conf, mat_conf_train, roc) {
  precision <- mat_conf[2, 2] / (mat_conf[1, 2] + mat_conf[2, 2])

  specificite <- mat_conf[1, 1] / (mat_conf[1, 1] + mat_conf[1, 2])

  err_esp_1 <- 1 - specificite

  sensibilite <- mat_conf[2, 2] / (mat_conf[2, 2] + mat_conf[2, 1])

  err_esp_2 <- 1 - sensibilite

  score_F1 <- 2 * (precision * sensibilite) / (precision + sensibilite)

  taux_err_test <- (mat_conf[1, 2] + mat_conf[2, 1]) / (mat_conf[1, 1] + mat_conf[1, 2] + mat_conf[2, 1] + mat_conf[2, 2])

  taux_err_train <- (mat_conf_train[1, 2] + mat_conf_train[2, 1]) / (mat_conf_train[1, 1] + mat_conf_train[1, 2] + mat_conf_train[2, 1] + mat_conf_train[2, 2])

  taux_correcte <- (mat_conf[1, 1] + mat_conf[2, 2]) / (mat_conf[1, 1] + mat_conf[1, 2] + mat_conf[2, 1] + mat_conf[2, 2])

  auc <- auc(roc)

  return(rbind(
    `Précision` = precision,
    `Spécificité` = specificite,
    `Taux de faux positifs` = err_esp_1,
    `Taux de faux négatifs` = err_esp_2,
    `Sensibilité` = sensibilite,
    `F-score` = score_F1,
    `Taux d'erreur en test` = taux_err_test,
    `Taux d'erreur en entraînement` = taux_err_train,
    AUC = auc,
    Accuracy = taux_correcte
  ))
}


matrice_confusion <- function(fit, titre = NULL){
  conf_test <- data.frame(
    Réalité = ech_test$churn,
    Prédiction = fit$.predictions[[1]]$.pred_class
  ) |> table() |> addmargins()
  
  colnames(conf_test)[3] <- "Total"
  rownames(conf_test)[3] <- "Total"
  
  df_conf_test <- data.frame(
    " " = c(rep("Réalité", 2)," "),
    " " = c(0, 1, "Total"),
    "0" = c(conf_test[1,1],conf_test[2,1],conf_test[3,1]),
    "1" = c(conf_test[1,2],conf_test[2,2],conf_test[3,2]),
    Total = c(conf_test[1,3],conf_test[2,3],conf_test[3,3])
  )
  
  colnames(df_conf_test) <- c(" ", " ", 0, 1, "Total")
  
  df_conf_test |> 
    kable(align = "c", caption = titre, format = "markdown") |> 
    kable_paper(full_width = FALSE) |>
    column_spec(c(1,2,5), bold = TRUE) |>
    row_spec(c(0,3), bold = TRUE) |>
    row_spec(0, color = "brown") |> 
    column_spec(2, color = "brown") |> 
    collapse_rows(columns = 1:2,valign = "top") |> 
    add_header_above(c(" " = 2, "Prédiction" = 2, " " = 1), 
                     bold = TRUE, 
                     line = F) 
  
}



Courbe_roc <- function(roc, titre = NULL) {
  roc |> ggroc(legacy.axes = TRUE, colour = "darkgoldenrod", size = 1) +
    geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = 1, y = 0, yend = 1), color = "red", linetype = "dotted") +
    labs(title = titre,
         x = "1 - Spécificité",
         y = "Sensibilité") +
    mon_theme
}




perf_modele <- function(mat_conf_test, mat_conf_train, roc_test, titre = NULL, format = "markdown") {
  result_test <- Collecte_mesure(mat_conf_test, mat_conf_train, roc_test) |> round(4)

  result_test <- sprintf("%.2f%%", result_test * 100)

tbl <-   tibble(
    `Précision` = result_test[1],
    `Spécificité` = result_test[2],
    `Taux de faux positifis` = result_test[3],
    `Taux de faux négatifs` = result_test[4],
    `Sensibilité` = result_test[5],
    `F-score` = result_test[6],
    `Taux d'erreur test` = result_test[7],
    `Taux d'erreur train` = result_test[8],
    `AUC` = result_test[9],
    `Accuracy` = result_test[10]
  ) |>
    t() 

tbl |> 
    tableau_html(row.names = TRUE, titre = titre, format = format) |>
    column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, italic = TRUE) |> 
    footnote(
      number = c(
        "Taux de faux positifs : Proportion de clients prédits en résiliation qui ont renouvelé.",
        "Taux de faux négatifs : Proportion de clients prédits en renouvellement qui ont résilié."
           )) |> 
    column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) |> 
    column_spec(2, color = ifelse(rownames(tbl) %in% c("AUC", "F-score", "Accuracy"), "green", "black"))
  }




affichage_transparent <- function(
    plot = plot,
    height = height,
    scale = scale,
    width = 6) {
  plot_name <- deparse(substitute(plot))
  path <- here::here("image", paste0(plot_name, ".png"))

  suppressMessages(
    ggplot2::ggsave(
      plot = plot,
      path = dirname(path),
      filename = basename(path),
      bg = "transparent",
      height = height,
      scale = scale,
      dpi = 300,
      units = "in",
      width = width
    )
  )

  knitr::include_graphics(path)
}
```

# Analyse descriptive

## Variables quantitatives

### Test t de Student pour échantillons indépendants


$$\begin{cases} H_0: \mu_e = \mu_p \\H_1:\mu_e \ne \mu_p \end{cases} | \ \text{Au risque} \ \alpha = 5 \% \ \text{, on a une} \ p_{value}<0.05$$

```{r ttest}
quant <- which(sapply(df, is.numeric))

ttest_val <- map_dfr(quant, ~ t.test(df[[.x]] ~ df$churn, var.equal = FALSE) |>
  tidy() |>
  mutate(Variable = names(df)[.x]))


ttest <- data.frame(ttest_val) |>
  mutate(
    Variable = factor(Variable, levels = names(df)),
    estimate = round(estimate, 2),
    estimate1 = round(estimate1, 2),
    estimate2 = round(estimate2, 2),
    p.value = formatC(p.value, format = "e", digits = 2),
    conf.low = round(conf.low, 2),
    conf.high = round(conf.high, 2)
  )

ttest |>
  dplyr::select(Variable, estimate, estimate1, estimate2, p.value, conf.low, conf.high) |>
  rename(
    `Variable` = Variable,
    `Estimate` = estimate,
    `µ1` = estimate1,
    `µ2` = estimate2,
    `IC inf` = conf.low,
    `IC sup` = conf.high,
    `p-value` = p.value
  ) |>
  tableau_html(titre = "Résultats des tests de student", format = "markdown", small = TRUE) |> 
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) |> 
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) |> 
  column_spec(6, color = ifelse(ttest_val[,5] > 0.05, "red", "black"))
```

### Test du $\chi^2$

```{r mani_quali}

charge_amount_2 <- ifelse(df$charge_amount %in% 3:10, "3-10", 
                          ifelse(df$charge_amount == 0, 0,
                          ifelse(df$charge_amount == 1, 1, 2)))

age_group_2 <- ifelse(df$age_group %in% 4:5, "4-5", df$age_group)

```


```{r test_chi2}
chi_complains <- chisq.test(df$complains, df$churn)
chi_charge <- chisq.test(charge_amount_2, df$churn)
chi_tariff <- chisq.test(df$tariff_plan, df$churn)
chi_status <- chisq.test(df$status, df$churn)
chi_age_group <- chisq.test(age_group_2, df$churn)

tab_chi <- rbind(
  cbind("t-stat", "p-value"),
  cbind(formatC(chi_complains$statistic, format = "e", digits = 2), formatC(chi_complains$p.value, format = "e", digits = 2)),
  cbind(formatC(chi_charge$statistic, format = "e", digits = 2), formatC(chi_charge$p.value, format = "e", digits = 2)),
  cbind(formatC(chi_tariff$statistic, format = "e", digits = 2), formatC(chi_tariff$p.value, format = "e", digits = 2)),
  cbind(formatC(chi_status$statistic, format = "e", digits = 2), formatC(chi_status$p.value, format = "e", digits = 2)),
  cbind(formatC(chi_age_group$statistic, format = "e", digits = 2), formatC(chi_age_group$p.value, format = "e", digits = 2))
)
rownames(tab_chi) <- c("Résultats", "Complains", "Charge amount", "Tariff plan", "Status", "Age Group")

tab_chi |>
  tableau_html(row.names = TRUE, format = "markdown", titre = "Résultats des tests") |> 
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) |> 
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)
```

## Optimisation des hyperparamètres



# Modèles



## Analyse discriminante linéaire (LDA)

Afin de débuter doucement notre analyse, nous allons effectuer une **LDA**, en effet ce modèle est toujours bon a tester etant donné sa robustesse et sa simplicité de mise en place, de plus il peut arriver que ce modèle nous permette d'obtenir des résultats non-négligeable s'il s'avère que la relation entre les données est majoritairement linéaire. 

### Spécification du modèle et Recette concoctée

```{r lda_spec, echo=TRUE, eval = FALSE, background="transparent"}
lda_spec <- discrim_linear() |>
  set_mode("classification") |>
  set_engine("MASS")

lda_rec <- recipe(churn ~ ., data = ech_train) |>
  step_center(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  step_scale(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  step_smotenc(churn, over_ratio = tune(), neighbors = tune()) |>
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) |>
  step_corr(all_numeric_predictors(), threshold = 0.9, method = "spearman")
```



### Optimisation des hyperparamètres

```{r lda_best, fig.align='center'}
load("modele/lda_tune_res.rda")
load("modele/Lda_fit.rda")

auto_tune_lda <- autoplot(lda_tune_res)

plot_lda <- auto_tune_lda$plot_env$dat

graph_auto_lda <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(
    data = plot_lda[
      plot_lda$.metric == "f_meas"&
      plot_lda$Threshold == 0.8,], 
    aes(x = value, y = mean, color = `# Nearest Neighbors` ), 
    size = 1
    )  + mon_theme + 
  labs(y = "F-measure", 
       x = "Over-ratio", 
       color = "Nombre de voisins",
       title = "Optimisation des hyperparamètres : LDA")

affichage_transparent(graph_auto_lda, 
                      height = 3, 
                      scale = 1,
                      width = 6)
```



```{r lda_tibble}
load("modele/lda_fit.rda")
```

## Analyse qualitative discriminante (QDA)

### Spécification du modèle et Recette concoctée



```{r qda_rec, echo=TRUE, eval=FALSE, background="transparent"}
qda_spec <- discrim_quad() |>
  set_mode("classification") |>
  set_engine("MASS")

qda_rec <- ech_train |>
  recipe(churn ~ ., strata) |>
  step_center(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  step_scale(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  step_smotenc(churn, over_ratio = tune(), neighbors = tune()) |>
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) |>
  step_corr(all_numeric_predictors(), threshold = tune(), method = "spearman")  
```

```{r qda_spec, eval=FALSE}


qda_wf <- workflow() %>% add_model(qda_spec) %>% add_recipe(qda_rec)

qda_folds <- vfold_cv(ech_train, v = 10, strata = churn, repeats = 3)

# Création de la grille de recherche
qda_range_para <- extract_parameter_set_dials(qda_wf) |>
  update(
    over_ratio = over_ratio(c(0.3,0.6)),
    neighbors = neighbors(c(2,7)),
    threshold = threshold(c(0.3,0.7))
  )

qda_grid <- grid_regular(
  qda_range_para,
  levels = c(over_ratio = 3, neighbors = 3, threshold = 5)
)

# Recherche des meilleurs paramètres
n_core <- detectCores(logical = TRUE)
registerDoParallel(cores = n_core - 1)


qda_tune <- tune_grid(
  object = qda_wf,
  resamples = qda_folds,
  grid = qda_grid,
  metrics = metric_set(
    roc_auc,
    accuracy,
    yardstick::precision,
    sens,
    spec,
    f_meas
  )
)

stopImplicitCluster()

save(qda_tune, file = "modele/qda_tune.rda")

# Sélection des meilleurs paramC(tres
qda_best_fscore <- qda_tune |>
    select_best("f_meas")

qda_best_auc <- qda_tune |>
    select_best("auc")

qda_best_acc <- qda_tune |>
    select_best("accuracy")

# Finalisation du modèle :
qda_final_wf <- qda_wf  |>
    finalize_workflow(qda_best_fscore)

qda_fit <- qda_final_wf |> last_fit(split = data_split)

save(qda_fit, file = "modele/qda_fit.rda")
```

## Classificateur naif bayésien (Naive Bayes)



### Spécification du modèle et Recette concoctée

```{r echo=TRUE, eval=FALSE}
naive_spec <- naive_Bayes(smoothness = tune(), Laplace = 1) %>%
  set_engine("naivebayes", usepoisson = TRUE) %>%
  set_mode("classification")

rec_bayes <- recipe(churn ~ ., data = ech_train) |>
  step_pca(all_numeric_predictors(), num_comp = 9) |>
  step_smotenc(churn, over_ratio = tune(), neighbors = tune()) |>
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors(), -all_outcomes())

```

```{r Construct_nb, eval=FALSE}


naive_workflow <- workflow() %>%
    add_recipe(rec_bayes) %>%
    add_model(naive_spec)

naive_para <- extract_parameter_set_dials(naive_workflow) |>
    update(
        smoothness = smoothness(c(10, 20)),
        over_ratio = over_ratio(c(0.3, 0.6)),
        neighbors = neighbors(c(3, 7))
    )

naive_grid <- grid_regular(naive_para, levels = c(5,4,5))

data_folds <- vfold_cv(ech_train,v=10, strata = churn, repeats = 3)

n_core<-detectCores(logical=TRUE)
registerDoParallel(cores = n_core - 1)

naive_tune <- naive_workflow %>%
    tune_grid(
        resamples = data_folds ,
        grid = naive_grid,
        metrics = metric_set(
            roc_auc,accuracy, 
            yardstick::precision, 
            yardstick::recall, 
            yardstick::f_meas
        )
    )

stopImplicitCluster()

save(naive_tune, file = "naive_tune.rda")

naive_para <- naive_tune |>
    select_best("f_meas")     

naive_workflow <- naive_workflow |>
    finalize_workflow(naive_para)

naive_fit_train <- naive_workflow %>% 
        fit(newdata = ech_train) 

save(naive_fit_train, file = "modele/naive_fit_train.rda")

```

## Arbre de décision CART

### Spécification du modèle et recette concoctée

```{r dec_spec, echo=TRUE, eval=FALSE}
dec_tree_spec <- decision_tree(cost_complexity = tune()) %>%
  set_mode("classification") %>%
  set_engine("rpart")

data_rec <- ech_train |>
  recipe(churn ~ ., strata = churn) |>
  step_center(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  step_scale(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  step_smotenc(churn, over_ratio = tune(), neighbors = tune()) |>
  step_corr(all_numeric_predictors(), threshold = 0.9, method = "spearman") 
```


```{r rec_dec_tree, eval=FALSE}

  

dec_tree_wf <- workflow() %>% add_model(dec_tree_spec) %>% add_recipe(data_rec)


df_folds <- vfold_cv(ech_train, v = 10, strata = churn, repeats = 3)

# Création de la grille de recherche
dec_tree_range_para <- extract_parameter_set_dials(dec_tree_wf) |>
  update(
    cost_complexity = cost_complexity(range = c(-5, -0.1)),
    over_ratio = over_ratio(range = c(0.3, 0.7)),
    neighbors = neighbors(range = c(2, 6))
  )

dec_tree_grid <- grid_regular(
  dec_tree_range_para,
  levels = c(over_ratio = 5, cost_complexity = 10, neighbors = 5)
)

# Recherche des meilleurs paramètres
n_core <- detectCores(logical = TRUE)
registerDoParallel(cores = n_core - 1)


dec_tree_tune <- tune_grid(
  object = dec_tree_wf,
```

### Optimisation des hyperparamètres

L'arbre de décision est un modèle simple et intuitif qui permet de visualiser les règles de décision. Il est robuste aux valeurs aberrantes et il est capable de gérer des variables qualitatives sans encodage particulier. Cependant, il est sensible au sur-apprentissage et à la variance des données. Nous allons donc construire un arbre de décision à **profondeur maximale** tout en optimisant le paramètre de **`coût de complexité`**. Ce paramètre permet de contrôler la croissance de l'arbre en pénalisant les branches supplémentaires, il nous permettra donc de trouver un compromis entre la complexité du modèle et son adéquation aux données d'apprentissage. Nous n'oublierons pas d'optimiser le ratio de suréchantillonnage et le nombre de voisins pour le suréchantillonnage **`SMOTE`**.

```{r dec_tree_opti_param, fig.align='center'}
load("modele/dec_tree_tune.RData")
load("modele/dec_tree_fit.RData")

auto_tune_dec_tree <- autoplot(dec_tree_tune)

plot_dec_tree <- auto_tune_dec_tree$plot_env$dat[
  auto_tune_dec_tree$plot_env$dat$.metric == "accuracy" & 
  auto_tune_dec_tree$plot_env$dat$`# Nearest Neighbors` == 2, ]


graph_auto_dec_tree <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = plot_dec_tree, aes(x = value, y = mean, color = `Over-Sampling Ratio`), size = 1) +
  mon_theme +
  labs(y = "Accuracy", 
       x = "Cost-Complexity Parameter",
       color = "Over-ratio",
       title = "Optimisation des hyperparamètres : Decision Tree")

affichage_transparent(graph_auto_dec_tree, 
                      height = 3, 
                      scale =1,
                      width = 6)
```

Les paramètres retenus permettront de maximiser la précision globale de l'arbre de décision :

```{r dec_tree_param}
tibble(
  `Cost-Complexity Parameter` =
    formatC(quo_get_expr(dec_tree_fit[[6]][[1]][["fit"]][["actions"]][["model"]][["spec"]][["args"]][["cost_complexity"]]), format = "e", digits = 2),
  `Over-ratio` = dec_tree_fit[[6]][[1]][["pre"]][["actions"]][["recipe"]][["recipe"]][["steps"]][[3]][["over_ratio"]],
  `Neighbors` = dec_tree_fit[[6]][[1]][["pre"]][["actions"]][["recipe"]][["recipe"]][["steps"]][[3]][["neighbors"]]
) |>
  tableau_html(titre = "Hyperparamètres retenus", row.names = FALSE, format = "markdown") |> 
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)
```

L'arbre de décision possède l'avantage de pouvoir être représenté graphiquement, ce qui permet de visualiser les règles de décision. Nous allons donc afficher l'arbre de décision obtenu :

```{r visu_dec_tree}
dec_tree_fit |>
  extract_fit_engine() |>
  rpart.plot::prp(
    type = 0, extra = 1,
    roundint = FALSE
  )
```

Il est intéressant de constater que les deux premières variables utilisées pour classer les individus sont **`status`** et **`complain`** qui sont deux des variables qui ont un impact significatif sur la probabilité de résiliation du contrat selon le modèle de régression logistique.

## Forêt aléatoire

### Spécification du modèle et recette concoctée

```{r rf_spec, eval=FALSE, echo=TRUE}
# Spécification du modèle :

rf_spec <- rand_forest(mtry = tune(), trees = tune(), min_n = 1) |>
  set_engine("ranger", importance = "impurity") |>
  set_mode("classification")

# Création de la recette
rec <- recipe(churn ~ ., data = ech_train) |>
  step_center(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  step_scale(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  step_smotenc(over_ratio = tune(), skip = TRUE, neighbors = tune()) |>
  step_corr(all_numeric_predictors(), threshold = 0.9, method = "spearman") 
```


```{r Construct_rf, eval=FALSE}

rf_wf <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(rec) %>%
  add_model(rf_spec)

df_folds <- vfold_cv(ech_train, v = 10, strata = churn, repeats = 3)

# Création de la grille de recherche
rf_range_para <- extract_parameter_set_dials(rf_wf) |>
  update(
    mtry = mtry(c(4, 10)),
    trees = trees(c(50, 500)),
    over_ratio = over_ratio(c(0.3, 0.6)),
    neighbors = neighbors(c(2, 7))
  )

rf_grid <- grid_regular(
  rf_range_para,
  levels = c(mtry = 7, trees = 10, over_ratio = 4, neighbors = 3)
)

# Recherche des meilleurs paramètres
n_core <- detectCores(logical = TRUE)
registerDoParallel(cores = n_core - 1)


rf_tune <- tune_grid(
  object = rf_wf,
  resamples = df_folds,
  grid = rf_grid,
  metrics = metric_set(
    roc_auc,
    accuracy,
    yardstick::precision,
    sens,
    spec,
    f_meas
  )
)


stopImplicitCluster()

save(rf_tune, file = "modele/rf_tune.rda")


# Sélection des meilleurs paramC(tres
rf_best_auc <- rf_tune |>
  select_best("auc")
  
rf_best_acc <- rf_tune |>
  select_best("accuracy")

rf_best_fscore <- rf_tune |>
  select_best("f_meas")

#Finalisation du modèle :
rf_final_wf <- rf_wf  |>
  finalize_workflow(rf_best_auc)

# Entrainement du modèle :
rf_fit <- rf_final_wf |> last_fit(split = data_split)

save(rf_fit, file = "modele/rf_fit.rda")
```

## Boosting


### Spécification du modèle et Recette concoctée
<!-- \vspace{-3cm} -->
```{r boost_spec, echo=TRUE, eval = FALSE}
boost_spec <- boost_tree(
  trees = tune(),
  tree_depth = tune(),
  learn_rate = tune(),
  mtry = tune()
) |>
  set_engine("xgboost") |>
  set_mode("classification")

boost_rec <- recipe(churn ~ ., data = ech_train) |>
  step_center(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  step_scale(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  step_smotenc(churn, over_ratio = tune(), neighbors = tune()) |>
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors())
```
<!-- \vspace{-5cm} -->


```{r grille_boosting ,eval = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
data_folds <- vfold_cv(ech_train, v = 10, strata = churn, repeats = 3)

boosting_param <- extract_parameter_set_dials(boosting_workflow) |>
  update(
    trees = trees(range = c(500, 1500)),
    tree_depth = tree_depth(range = c(3, 11)),
    learn_rate = learn_rate(range = c(-4, -1), trans = log10_trans()),
    over_ratio = over_ratio(range = c(0.4, 0.4)),
    neighbors = neighbors(range = c(3, 7)),
    mtry = mtry(range = c(4, 8))
  )

boosting_grid <- grid_regular(
  boosting_param,
  levels = c(
    trees = 6, tree_depth = 5, learn_rate = 4, mtry = 5,
    over_ratio = 3, neighbors = 3
  )
)

n_core <- detectCores(logical = TRUE)
registerDoParallel(cores = n_core - 2)

boosting_tune_res <- tune_grid(
  boosting_workflow,
  resamples = data_folds,
  grid = boosting_grid,
  metrics = metric_set(
    yardstick::recall,
    accuracy,
    f_meas
  )
)

stopImplicitCluster()

save(boosting_tune_res,file="boosting_tune_res.rda")

best_boo_parameters <- select_best(boosting_tune_res, "f_meas")

final_boosting_wf <- boosting_workflow |>
  finalize_workflow(best_boo_parameters)

boost_fit <- final_boosting_wf |> last_fit(split = data_split)

save(boost_fit, file = "modele/Boosting_fit_2.rda")
```

```{r perf_compar}
mesure_perf_dec_tree <- cbind(result_dec_tree[1], result_dec_tree[5], result_dec_tree[6], result_dec_tree[9], result_dec_tree[10])
colnames(mesure_perf_dec_tree) <- c("Précision", "Sensibilité", "F_score", "AUC", "Accuracy")
rownames(mesure_perf_dec_tree) <- "Decision Tree"

mesure_perf_rf <- cbind(result_rf[1], result_rf[5], result_rf[6], result_rf[9], result_rf[10])
colnames(mesure_perf_rf) <- c("Précision", "Sensibilité", "F_score", "AUC", "Accuracy")
rownames(mesure_perf_rf) <- "Random Forest"

mesure_perf_boost <- cbind(result_boost[1], result_boost[5], result_boost[6], result_boost[9], result_boost[10])
colnames(mesure_perf_boost) <- c("Précision", "Sensibilité", "F_score", "AUC", "Accuracy")
rownames(mesure_perf_boost) <- "Boosting"

toutes_perf <- rbind(mesure_perf_lda, mesure_perf_qda, mesure_perf_knn, mesure_perf_naive, mesure_perf_svmr, mesure_perf_logit, mesure_perf_dec_tree, mesure_perf_rf, mesure_perf_boost) 

toutes_perf |>
  tableau_html(format = "markdown", row.names = TRUE) |> 
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) |> 
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) |> 
  column_spec(2, color = ifelse(toutes_perf[,1] == max(toutes_perf[,1]), "green", ifelse(toutes_perf[,1] == min(toutes_perf[,1]), "red", "black"))) |> 
  column_spec(3, color = ifelse(toutes_perf[,2] == max(toutes_perf[,2]), "green", ifelse(toutes_perf[,2] == min(toutes_perf[,2]), "red", "black"))) |>
  column_spec(4, color = ifelse(toutes_perf[,3] == max(toutes_perf[,3]), "green", ifelse(toutes_perf[,3] == min(toutes_perf[,3]), "red", "black"))) |>
  column_spec(5, color = ifelse(toutes_perf[,4] == max(toutes_perf[,4]), "green", ifelse(toutes_perf[,4] == min(toutes_perf[,4]), "red", "black"))) |>
  column_spec(6, color = ifelse(toutes_perf[,5] == max(toutes_perf[,5]), "green", ifelse(toutes_perf[,5] == min(toutes_perf[,5]), "red", "black")))
```





## Optimisation du boosting


```{r boost_seuil}
load("modele/Boosting_fit_2.rda")

mesure_perf_boost_thresh <- NULL
range_threshold <- seq(0.1, 0.9, 0.01)

for (i in range_threshold) {
  boost_pred_thresh <- predict(boost_fit$.workflow[[1]], new_data = ech_test, type = "prob")
  boost_pred_thresh$.pred_class <- ifelse(boost_pred_thresh$.pred_1 > i, 1, 0)
  boost_conf_mat_thresh <- data.frame(
    Réalité = ech_test$churn,
    Prédiction = boost_pred_thresh$.pred_class
  ) |> table()

  roc_boost_thresh <- roc(ech_test$churn, boost_pred_thresh$.pred_1)
  result_thresh <- Collecte_mesure(boost_conf_mat_thresh, NULL, roc_boost_thresh) |> t()
  mesure_perf_boost_thresh <- rbind(mesure_perf_boost_thresh, cbind(result_thresh[1], result_thresh[5], result_thresh[6], result_thresh[9], i))
}

colnames(mesure_perf_boost_thresh) <- c("Précision", "Sensibilité", "F_score", "Accuracy", "threshold")


graph_mesure <- ggplot(data = as.data.frame(mesure_perf_boost_thresh)) +
  geom_line(aes(x = threshold, y = Sensibilité, color = "Sensibilité")) +
  geom_line(aes(x = threshold, y = Précision, color = "Précision")) +
  geom_line(aes(x = threshold, y = F_score, color = "F_score")) +
  geom_line(aes(x = threshold, y = Accuracy, color = "Accuracy")) +
  mon_theme +
  labs(
    title = "Evolution des performances selon le seuil",
    y = " "
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Sensibilité" = "blue", "Précision" = "red", "F_score" = "green", "Accuracy" = "gold"), name = "Mesure")

affichage_transparent(graph_mesure, 
                      height = 3, 
                      scale = 1,
                      width = 6)
```



## Seuil de classification optimal

```{r seuil_opti}
mesure_perf_boost_thresh <- data.frame(mesure_perf_boost_thresh)

mesure_perf_boost_thresh <- mesure_perf_boost_thresh |>
  mutate(Moyenne = (Sensibilité + Précision + F_score + Accuracy) / 4)

mesure_perf_boost_thresh <- mesure_perf_boost_thresh |>
  arrange(desc(Moyenne)) |>
  head(5) 
mesure_perf_boost_thresh |> 
  tableau_html(titre = "Meilleurs seuils de classification", format = "markdown", row.names = FALSE) |> 
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) |> 
  column_spec(1, color = ifelse(mesure_perf_boost_thresh[,1] == max(mesure_perf_boost_thresh[,1]), "green","black")) |>
  column_spec(2, color = ifelse(mesure_perf_boost_thresh[,2] == max(mesure_perf_boost_thresh[,2]), "green","black")) |>
  column_spec(3, color = ifelse(mesure_perf_boost_thresh[,3] == max(mesure_perf_boost_thresh[,3]), "green","black")) |>
  column_spec(4, color = ifelse(mesure_perf_boost_thresh[,4] == max(mesure_perf_boost_thresh[,4]), "green","black")) |>
  column_spec(6, color = ifelse(mesure_perf_boost_thresh[,6] == max(mesure_perf_boost_thresh[,6]), "green","black"))
```
